intro: These people chose to book a country band for their event and didn't regret it. Here are some kind words from our Tennessee Whiskey alumni.

reviews.text: You were absolutely brilliant and we loved having you part of the event. Customers were already asking about whether you'll be back next year!
reviews.author: Sarah W

reviews.text: Thank you for a fantastic night! Everybody loved it and I've had so many people saying they loved the band!
reviews.author: Laura F

reviews.text: Thank you so much for your performance and interaction last night, it really was the highlight of the weekend and everyone loved it — especially our bride to be!
reviews.author: Gemma B

reviews.text: Fantastic performers. Great interaction and a good mix of music. They are a lovely set of lads and really got the party going for my friend's hen do — they really got into the spirit of things too!
reviews.author: Kimberley F

reviews.text: Absolutely superb experience with this band. Played at our wedding and went down a storm. Communication was great, the song choices were great and they were just a great bunch of guys to have around!
reviews.author: Tom H

reviews.text: Tennessee Whiskey provided a great band for our student club night. They got people dancing and were an excellent overall addition to our event.
reviews.author: Daniel R

reviews.text: Tennessee Whiskey were excellent!! Every one of the 300 people at our event loved their performance and couldn't speak highly enough of it.
reviews.author: Harry P
